snippet.title: عطل عالمي في البنوك: هل دي بداية النهاية للتعاملات الرقمية؟
snippet.description:
تفتح تطبيق البنك ومش قادر تستخدم بعض الخدمات، أو تبعت تحويل ويفضل معلّق. تتصرف إزاي؟ وهل تعيد المحاولة ولا تستنى؟
في الحلقة دي من «المصرفي»، بنشرح إيه اللي حصل في عطل JPMorgan Chase في أمريكا، وليه بعض العملاء واجهوا مشاكل في الأونلاين البنكي وتأخير في التحويلات. وبنوضح إيه اللي اتأكد عن ماكينات الصراف الآلي ATM، وإيه اللي لسه غير مؤكد.
ومن الواقعة دي، بناخد خطوات عملية تنفعك سواء حسابك في مصر أو برّه: إزاي تراجع حالة العملية، وإمتى تتواصل مع البنك، وإيه البيانات اللي تحتفظ بيها قبل ما تحاول تاني.
What happened during the JPMorgan Chase outage, and what should you do if your banking app stops working or a transfer gets stuck?
#JPMorganChase #البنوك #المصرفي
اخترت أبدأ بموقف أي عميل بنك ممكن يواجهه، وأكتب JPMorgan Chase بالإنجليزي عشان اسم الواقعة يبقى واضح للي بيدوّر عليها. والغلاف يكمل العنوان بسؤال أقصر «بنكك عطّل… تعمل إيه؟».

تطبيق البنك معطل أو التحويلات معلقة؟ اعرف إزاي تتعامل مع أعطال البنوك التقنية زي اللي حصلت في JPMorgan Chase.

بنناقش في حلقة النهارده إيه اللي حصل في أعطال البنوك الكبرى زي تشيس، أمريكا، وويلز فارجو، وليه واجه العملاء صعوبات في استخدام ماكينات الصراف الآلي أو الخدمات المصرفية عبر الإنترنت. بنوضح الأسباب التقنية وراء المشكلة والفرق بين التعامل مع تحويل بنكي متأخر أو تعطل كامل في النظام، عشان تكون مستعد لو واجهت موقف مشابه في حسابك البنكي سواء داخل مصر أو خارجها.

الهدف من الحلقة هو تقديم خطوات عملية تضمن حقك المالي، بداية من إمتى تتواصل مع خدمة العملاء وصولاً للبيانات اللي لازم تحتفظ بيها قبل إعادة المحاولة. بنشرح كمان إزاي تراجع حالة العملية البنكية المعلقة لضمان سلامة أموالك في ظل تقلبات الأداء الرقمي للمؤسسات المالية.

اشترك في المصرفي لمتابعة تحليلاتنا المالية الدورية، واكتب لنا في التعليقات: هل واجهت أي مشاكل تقنية في تطبيق بنكك مؤخراً؟

snippet.title: Major bank outages hit Chase, Wells Fargo, Bank of America
snippet.description:
Customers of several major U.S. banks reported problems accessing their accounts Monday, as outages affected Chase, Wells Fargo and Bank of America.

Thousands of customers reported issues with online banking services, including problems accessing their accounts and completing transactions.

At one point, roughly 4,700 online account issues were reported as customers experienced disruptions.

Chase later said transactions had returned to normal following the outage.

The bank also said the disruption was not caused by a cyberattack.

Other major financial institutions, including Wells Fargo and Bank of America, were among those experiencing reported service issues.

The banking disruptions came as Microsoft addressed a separate outage affecting its Outlook email service.

Microsoft said that outage was caused by an undetected bug, not a cyberattack or an issue involving artificial intelligence.

In a statement, Microsoft executive Charles Lamanna said the company was taking responsibility for the disruption.

"This was not a cyberattack or an issue caused by AI tooling," Lamanna said. "Our amazing team was able to work through a very challenging situation to restore service."

Lamanna said the company's investigation pointed to technical problems and cascading failures that complicated recovery efforts.

The company said it would conduct a full review to determine what went wrong and help prevent similar disruptions in the future.

snippet.title: Bank Outage Today? Do These 3 Things Before Autopay Hits You
snippet.description:
If you bank with Chase, Wells Fargo, or Bank of America, do not assume your autopay went through today.

A bank glitch can follow you if a payment is late. Here are the 3 things I need you to do:

1. Check every bill you have on autopay. Mortgage, car note, credit card, line of credit, and anything you pay from that bank.

2. Call each creditor before you pay it yourself. There can be a delay, and you do not want to make a double payment if you do not have to.

3. Screenshot your ending balances. If the bank comes back with a number that looks off, you want verification. Your money is insured, but they are not going to go based on your word.

The outage may already be wrapping up. That does not protect you if the bank missed an autopay or had an error on your behalf.

snippet.title: Bank of America Says It Was Fine. So What Broke?
snippet.description:
Was Monday's big bank outage a bug or a hack? And why did Bank of America customers see trouble when the bank says its systems were fine?

Customers of several large US banks reported trouble with apps, online banking and transfers on Monday, Nov 16. Bank of America drew about two thousand reports on Downdetector by 2 pm ET, yet the bank says its systems have been operating normally. JPMorgan Chase says a software bug in an on-premise hardware system slowed some transactions, and that it was not cyber related; other banks may have been affected where Chase was a party to the payment. By about 6:30 pm ET, Chase said transactions were posting normally again. We explain how one bank's bug can reach another bank's customers, what Downdetector numbers do and do not show, and how to avoid the scams that follow outages like this.

Facts current as of 9:10 pm ET, Nov 16 2026.

snippet.title: Bank of America: Don't Share Your Bank Password With AI Agents
snippet.description:
Bank of America (Oct 27, 2026): the bank emailed customers a note titled "Protecting your finances in the AI World," and a spokesperson confirmed to TechCrunch that the email is real. The ask is simple: do not share your username or password with an outside service, including an AI-enabled tool or agent that offers to act on your behalf. If you do share your credentials, the email says you are responsible for activity resulting from that access.

JPMorgan and Citi are also restricting third-party AI agents (Axios, USA Today). Citi told USA Today it does not let those agents log in or make transactions for customers. Axios reports that many banks cannot yet tell whether an agent is following the customer's instructions or has gone rogue, and that most banks have authorized, or are moving toward, read-only access: an AI can see your finances without moving your money. Citi already allows limited, read-only access through approved open-banking providers.

Keep your login to yourself. If you want an AI to look, use your bank's approved partners, and check your bank's own terms first. This brief covers US banks only. Rules differ by bank and by country.

snippet.title: Major Bank outage 11.18.2026
snippet.description:
The Chase outage on November 16 froze bank apps, balances and Zelle payments across the U.S. Chase lit up Downdetector with more than 4,700 reports, and Bank of America, Wells Fargo and U.S. Bank started lighting up right after.

Chase says it wasn't a cyberattack. It was a software bug inside Chase's own systems that slowed its payments to a crawl. Other banks only slowed down when their payments had to go through Chase.

By about 6:30 p.m. that evening, Chase said transactions were posting normally again. It was the fourth big U.S. outage in five days, after an email outage and grounded flights.

snippet.title: US Bank Outage: अमेरिका के बड़े बैंकों पर साइबर संकट? Chase समेत 6 बैंकों की ऑनलाइन सेवाएं ठप
snippet.description:
अमेरिका में एक बार फिर बड़ा तकनीकी संकट देखने को मिला है। सोमवार को Chase, Bank of America, JPMorgan, US Bank और Wells Fargo समेत कई बड़े बैंकों के ग्राहकों ने ऑनलाइन बैंकिंग सेवाओं में परेशानी की शिकायत की। डाउनडिटेक्टर के मुताबिक, सबसे ज्यादा 4,829 शिकायतें Chase बैंक को लेकर दर्ज की गईं। कई ग्राहक अपना बैंक बैलेंस और हाल के ट्रांजेक्शन नहीं देख पाए, जबकि कुछ को लॉग इन और पैसे ट्रांसफर करने में भी दिक्कत हुई। पेमेंट नेटवर्क Zelle में भी शिकायतें सामने आईं।

माइक्रोसॉफ्ट के बड़े आउटेज और FAA की तकनीकी खराबी के कुछ ही दिनों बाद हुई इस घटना ने अमेरिका के डिजिटल इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर पर सवाल खड़े कर दिए हैं। आखिर क्यों बार-बार तकनीकी सिस्टम में रुकावट आ रही है? क्या डिजिटल व्यवस्था पर बढ़ती निर्भरता नया खतरा बन रही है? जानिए इस खास रिपोर्ट में।
